mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 79 degrees at Fireman's Park under clear skies with the moon in its first quarter phase. If you are looking up tonight at 9:33 PM, look northwest toward Verona High School to spot the space station traveling toward Fitchburg for six minutes, reaching halfway up the sky.

City Hall is highlighting two key services today. First, you can stay informed through the VHAT cable channel or their YouTube page. Second, if you have food scraps, remember they are great for composting, and you can drop them off for free at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop after registering.

We have a busy week ahead starting with trivia tonight at Hop Haus and Lake Louie. Tomorrow, look forward to the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park and yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by Concerts in the Park this Thursday at Century School Park.
On July 16, officers were called to a burglary in progress on West Verona Avenue, which ended up being a neighbor dispute that resulted in an arrest for criminal trespass.
You can enjoy today's Chocolate Caramel Twist until the store closes at 10 PM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor of the day will be Mint Explosion.
